titleByLocale.it: Trader senior del gas per conto proprio
titleByLocale.fr: Trader senior en gaz pour compte propre

jobs.description:
Mission

We are looking for a skilled Gas Prop Trader with proven record tojoin and contribute to the success of the Gas Trading Team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, executing and managing proprietary trading strategies in the European Gas markets within Alpiq’s risk remit.

Your main responsibilities

• Develop, implement, and execute trading strategies, on fundamental and technical analysis around European gas location spreads.

• Analyse energy market trends and data to optimize strategies.

• Work with Fundamentals Analysts on models, identify and address areas for enhancement to enable growth of the business.

• Working knowledge of all relevant market operations and execution.

• Good communication skills to enable work within the Gas Desk, Analysts, Risk Teams and Management.

• Manage Trading positions of their book as well as team’s portfolios.

• The ability to work effectively in a team environment and contribute toinformation sharing within the gas desk as well as within merchant trading.

• Manage relationships with counterparties and brokers.

• Ensure compliance with regulations and internal guidelines

Your profile

• Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in economics and/or other quantitative field.

• Experience and proven track record as a Natural Gas Proprietary Trader.

• Working knowledge of all relevant market operations and execution (experience of managing physical gas delivery on European hubs is an advantage).

• Experience and proven track record as a Natural Gas Proprietary or Flow Trader.

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills.

• Team player with Excellent communication skills

• Demonstrable track record of producing sustainable revenue from trading activities

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Cerchiamo un/una trader esperto/a nel trading proprietario del gas, con una comprovata esperienza, per entrare a far parte del team di trading del gas e contribuire al suo successo. La persona selezionata sarà responsabile dello sviluppo, dell'esecuzione e della gestione di strategie di trading proprietario nei mercati europei del gas, nell'ambito del perimetro di rischio di Alpiq.

Le tue principali responsabilità

- Sviluppare, implementare ed eseguire strategie di trading basate sull'analisi fondamentale e tecnica degli spread geografici del gas europeo.
- Analizzare le tendenze e i dati dei mercati energetici per ottimizzare le strategie.
- Collaborare con gli analisti dei fondamentali sui modelli, individuare e affrontare le aree di miglioramento per favorire la crescita dell'attività.
- Conoscenza pratica di tutte le operazioni di mercato rilevanti e della loro esecuzione.
- Buone capacità comunicative per lavorare con il desk del gas, gli analisti, i team di rischio e la direzione.
- Gestire le posizioni di trading del proprio portafoglio e i portafogli del team.
- Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente di squadra e di contribuire alla condivisione delle informazioni all'interno del desk del gas e del trading merchant.
- Gestire i rapporti con le controparti e i broker.
- Garantire la conformità alle normative e alle linee guida interne

Il tuo profilo

- Laurea triennale e magistrale in economia e/o in un'altra disciplina quantitativa.
- Esperienza e risultati comprovati nel ruolo di trader proprietario di gas naturale.
- Conoscenza pratica di tutte le operazioni di mercato rilevanti e della loro esecuzione (l'esperienza nella gestione della consegna fisica del gas presso gli hub europei costituisce un vantaggio).
- Esperienza e risultati comprovati nel ruolo di trader proprietario o trader di flusso nel settore del gas naturale.
- Spiccate capacità analitiche e quantitative.
- Persona orientata al lavoro di squadra con eccellenti capacità comunicative
- Comprovata capacità di generare ricavi sostenibili attraverso le attività di trading

descriptionByLocale.de:
Auftrag

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Prop-Trader für Gas mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz, der dem Gas-Trading-Team beitritt und zu dessen Erfolg beiträgt. Die erfolgreiche Person ist für die Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Steuerung proprietärer Handelsstrategien auf den europäischen Gasmärkten im Rahmen des von Alpiq vorgegebenen Risikorahmens verantwortlich.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

- Entwicklung, Implementierung und Ausführung von Handelsstrategien auf Grundlage fundamentaler und technischer Analysen zu europäischen Gas-Location-Spreads.
- Analyse von Trends und Daten des Energiemarktes zur Optimierung der Strategien.
- Mit Fundamentalanalysten an Modellen arbeiten, Bereiche mit Verbesserungspotenzial identifizieren und bearbeiten, um das Wachstum des Geschäfts zu ermöglichen.
- Praktische Kenntnisse aller relevanten Marktprozesse und der Handelsausführung.
- Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Gas-Desks sowie mit Analysten, Risikoteams und dem Management zu ermöglichen.
- Steuerung der Handelspositionen des eigenen Buchs sowie der Portfolios des Teams.
- Die Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem Teamumfeld zu arbeiten und zum Informationsaustausch innerhalb des Gas-Desks sowie im Merchant Trading beizutragen.
- Pflege der Beziehungen zu Kontrahenten und Brokern.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Vorschriften und internen Richtlinien

Ihr Profil

- Bachelor- und Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften und/oder einem anderen quantitativen Fachgebiet.
- Erfahrung und nachweisbare Erfolge als Erdgas-Eigenhändler.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse aller relevanten Marktprozesse und der Handelsausführung (Erfahrung mit der Abwicklung physischer Gaslieferungen an europäischen Hubs ist von Vorteil).
- Erfahrung und nachweisbare Erfolge als Erdgas-Eigen- oder Flow-Trader.
- Ausgeprägte analytische und quantitative Fähigkeiten.
- Teamplayer mit ausgezeichneten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Erzielung nachhaltiger Erträge aus Handelsaktivitäten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Nous recherchons un trader propriétaire gaz expérimenté, avec une expérience avérée, pour rejoindre l’équipe de trading gaz et contribuer à son succès. La personne retenue sera chargée de développer, d’exécuter et de gérer des stratégies de trading pour compte propre sur les marchés européens du gaz, dans le cadre des limites de risque d’Alpiq.

Vos principales responsabilités

- Développer, mettre en œuvre et exécuter des stratégies de trading fondées sur des analyses fondamentales et techniques des spreads de localisation du gaz en Europe.
- Analyser les tendances et les données des marchés de l’énergie afin d’optimiser les stratégies.
- Collaborer avec les analystes fondamentaux sur les modèles, identifier et traiter les domaines à améliorer afin de permettre la croissance de l’activité.
- Avoir une bonne connaissance pratique de toutes les opérations de marché et de l’exécution pertinentes.
- Disposer de bonnes compétences en communication pour permettre le travail au sein du desk gaz, avec les analystes, les équipes risques et la direction.
- Gérer les positions de trading de son portefeuille ainsi que les portefeuilles de l’équipe.
- Être capable de travailler efficacement en équipe et de contribuer au partage d’informations au sein du desk gaz ainsi que dans le cadre du trading marchand.
- Gérer les relations avec les contreparties et les courtiers.
- Veiller au respect de la réglementation et des directives internes

Votre profil

- Diplôme de bachelor et de master en économie et/ou dans un autre domaine quantitatif.
- Expérience et parcours éprouvé en tant que trader propriétaire de gaz naturel.
- Bonne connaissance pratique de toutes les opérations de marché et de l’exécution pertinentes (une expérience de la gestion de livraisons physiques de gaz sur les hubs européens constitue un avantage).
- Expérience et parcours éprouvé en tant que trader propriétaire ou trader de flux de gaz naturel.
- Solides compétences analytiques et quantitatives.
- Esprit d’équipe avec d’excellentes compétences en communication
- Capacité démontrée à générer des revenus durables grâce aux activités de trading

jobs.description:
ICTs

OT Network & System Engineer

•

Lausanne, CH - 100% | Full time

About the Role

Role type: Permanent | Location: Switzerland | Model: On-Site | Level of travels: 10 %

Send us your application

Are you looking to make an impact in the energy sector? Become part of Alpiq - your energy matters!

Apply now

Our Company

Alpiq is one of Switzerland’s leading electricity producers and a key energy services provider across Europe. Headquartered in Lausanne and powered by a strong portfolio of hydropower, nuclear, and renewable energy sources, we’re all about impact, for the climate, for people, and for the security of supply.

More than 1,300 colleagues from nearly 60 nationalities bring their energy to a shared purpose: Together for a better climate and an improved security of supply.

We work in a values-driven culture shaped by trust, curiosity, and respect. Our 4 company values have been co-created with our employees and are embedded in everything we do as a company:

“We are ALP1Q “- reflects our team spirit

“We learn and grow together” - we have courage

“We share the steering wheel” - we take ownership

“We focus on the outcome” - your impact matters

At Alpiq, your energy matters!

M ission

Ensure the operational security of Alpiq’s critical OT infrastructure by protecting industrial networks, control systems and communication flows. Define, maintain and continuously improve technical OT cybersecurity measures to reduce operational risks, strengthen asset resilience and help increase security maturity across Alpiq, its affiliated companies and its partners.

Position characteristics

Operational role in administering, monitoring and maintaining OT infrastructure, including direct responsibility for managing network security equipment.

• Expert role in cybersecurity for critical OT and industrial environments.

• Maintain and develop OT network architecture, segmentation, configurations and associated documentation.

• Contribute to projects, audits and improvement initiatives, acting as a technical expert for sites and partners.

• Participate in the on-call service to ensure the continuity and resilience of critical OT environments.

• Collaborate with OT, IT, cybersecurity and operations teams.
Your main responsibilities

• Security equipment management (firewalls, PAM, threat detection, SIEM, etc.) Administer, configure and maintain the equipment. Design filtering rules, analyse flows, approve communication openings and perform periodic reviews in accordance with segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.Analyse and address alerts generated by this equipment, as well as SOC alerts.

• IT for OT systems management Administer, configure and maintain Windows- and Linux-based systems and appliances.

• Network architecture and segmentation Contribute to defining and developing OT network security architectures, trust zones and interconnections with IT environments and partners.

• OT governance and cybersecurity Define, implement and maintain cybersecurity measures applicable to OT infrastructure. Contribute to standards, directives, risk assessments and remediation plans.

• Support for partner companies : Advise and support Alpiq’s partner companies in securing their OT environments.

• Security maturity Contribute to maturity assessments, audits and the monitoring of measures designed to sustainably strengthen the security level of industrial infrastructure.

• Expertise and incident response Provide expert support to projects and operations, participate in security incident analysis, and contribute to technical investigations and corrective actions.

• Documentation and continuous improvement Maintain documentation for architectures, configurations, filtering rules and procedures. Keep abreast of threats, technologies and industrial security frameworks.

• 24/7 on-call service Participate in the on-call service for IT for OT, Facility Management and OT security.
Your impact

• By strengthening the security, resilience and maturity of Alpiq’s OT environments, this position helps safeguard business continuity, support operational excellence and protect critical energy assets from evolving cyber threats.

Your profile

• Higher education in IT, networks, telecommunications, cybersecurity or an equivalent field.

• 5 years experience in OT cybersecurity and firewall administration.

• Knowledge of critical infrastructure and industrial or hydropower environments is an advantage.

• Experience in consulting, supporting partners or assessing security maturity.
Behavioral competencies

• Strong risk analysis skills and a strong sense of responsibility.

• Collaborative mindset.

• Ability to analyse risks and a strong sense of responsibility.

• Ability to advise, influence and support change.

• Communication tailored to technical and decision-making audiences.

• Autonomy, rigour and reliability in a critical environment.

• Collaborative mindset and ability to represent the organisation in industry forums.
Core requirements

• OT / ICS cybersecurity: Advanced

• Cybersecurity equipment administration: Expert

• Industrial network architecture and segmentation: Advanced

• OT cyber risk management: Advanced

• Incident investigation and response: Advanced

• OT security advisory and support: Advanced

• Communication: Advanced
Knowledge of cybersecurity standards

• SCADA environments and industrial control systems: Intermediate

• Windows Server and Linux administration: Advanced

• VMware virtualisation: Intermediate

• Technical French: Advanced

• Technical German: Intermediate

• Technical English: Advanced

ruolo operativo nell'amministrazione, monitoraggio e mantenimento dell'infrastruttura OT, compresa la responsabilità diretta per la gestione delle apparecchiature di sicurezza della rete.

• Contribuire a progetti, audit e iniziative di miglioramento, agendo come esperto tecnico per siti e partner.

Analizzare e indirizzare gli avvisi generati da questa apparecchiatura, così come gli avvisi SOC.

• Contribuisci a definire e sviluppare architetture di sicurezza di rete OT, zone di fiducia e interconnessioni con ambienti e partner IT.

• Definire, implementare e mantenere le misure di sicurezza informatica applicabili all'infrastruttura di OT. Contribuire a standard, direttive, valutazioni dei rischi e piani di bonifica.

• Sostegno alle aziende partner: consulenza e supporto alle aziende partner di Alpiq nel garantire i loro ambienti OT.

• Contribuire a valutazioni di maturità, audit e monitoraggio delle misure volte a rafforzare in modo sostenibile il livello di sicurezza delle infrastrutture industriali.

• Fornire un supporto esperto a progetti e operazioni, partecipare all'analisi degli incidenti di sicurezza e contribuire a indagini tecniche e azioni correttive.

• Documentazione e miglioramento continuo Mantenere la documentazione per architetture, configurazioni, regole di filtraggio e procedure. Tenere al passo le minacce, le tecnologie e i quadri di sicurezza industriale.

• Servizio on-call 24/7 Partecipa al servizio on-call per IT per OT, Facility Management e Sicurezza OT.
Il tuo impatto

• Rafforzando la sicurezza, la resilienza e la maturità degli ambienti OT di Alpiq, questa posizione aiuta a salvaguardare la continuità aziendale, a sostenere l’eccellenza operativa e a proteggere i beni energetici critici dall’evoluzione delle minacce informatiche.

Il tuo profilo

• Istruzione superiore in IT, reti, telecomunicazioni, sicurezza informatica o un campo equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza nella cybersecurity e nell'amministrazione del firewall.

• La conoscenza delle infrastrutture critiche e degli ambienti industriali o idroelettrici è un vantaggio.

• Esperienza nella consulenza, nel supporto dei partner o nella valutazione della maturità di sicurezza.
Competenze comportamentali

• Forte capacità di analisi del rischio e un forte senso di responsabilità.

• La mentalità collaborativa.

• Capacità di analizzare i rischi e un forte senso di responsabilità.

• Capacità di consigliare, influenzare e sostenere il cambiamento.

• Comunicazione su misura per il pubblico tecnico e decisionale.

• Autonomia, rigore e affidabilità in un ambiente critico.

• Mindset collaborativo e capacità di rappresentare l'organizzazione nei forum del settore.
Requisiti fondamentali

• OT / ICS cybersecurity: Avanzato

• Amministrazione apparecchiature di sicurezza informatica: esperto

• Architettura e segmentazione della rete industriale: Avanzato

• Gestione dei rischi informatici OT: Advanced

• Indagine e risposta degli incidenti: Avanzato

• Consulenza e supporto di sicurezza OT: Avanzato

• Comunicazione: Avanzato
Conoscenza degli standard di sicurezza informatica

• ambienti SCADA e sistemi di controllo industriale: Intermediate

• Gestione Windows Server e Linux: Avanzate

• virtualizzazione VMware: Intermediate

Alpiq ist einer der führenden Schweizer Stromproduzenten und ein wichtiger Energiedienstleister in ganz Europa. jobs.title: Head of BESS Asset Trading
jobs.description:
Mission

The Head of BESS Asset Trading serves as a strategic architect of Alpiq’s flexibility portfolio, shaping how Battery Energy Storage Systems are positioned to capture value in increasingly volatile and decarbonized energy markets. By steering the commercial strategy for these critical assets, the role ensures that Alpiq leverages its storage capabilities to strengthen market influence, enhance portfolio resilience, and secure long-term profitability across multiple time horizons.

Your main responsibilities

Portfolio Optimization & Development :

• Maximize the commercial value of Alpiq’s Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) by strategically optimizing their deployment across wholesale markets, ensuring operational efficiency, market responsiveness, and sustained profitability.

• Lead and contribute to asset valuation and investment assessment initiatives, working closely with quantitative teams and the analysis desk to deliver rigorous valuations and well-supported trading recommendations that guide strategic decision-making.

• Ensure a scalable and future-proof setup within Alpiq’s trading systems, enabling seamless integration of new assets, enhanced automation, and robust operational workflows that support long-term portfolio growth
Team Leadership :

• Direct and empower high-performing trading desks, analysts, and asset optimization teams.

• Foster a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement to achieve aggressive P&L targets.
Strategy Development :

• Translate market fundamentals and emerging trends into actionable, data-driven trading strategies.

• Develop and implement innovative quantitative algorithmic bidding techniques that leverage market conditions for optimal returns.
Risk & Governance :

• Operate within and enhance the company’s risk management frameworks and regulatory compliance.

• Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks associated with trading activities to safeguard company assets and ensure long-term sustainability.
Cross-Functional Collaboration :

• Coordinate efforts with Asset Division, Asset Optimization, Risk, Middle Office, Analysis and Origination teams to ensure seamless commercial performance of assets.

• Enhance communication flows and data sharing across departments to support decision-making processes that benefit asset performance.
Performance Metrics & Reporting :

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators (PnL) related to trading, portfolio performance, and overall market position.

• Provide strategic insights and data-driven recommendations to senior leadership on optimizing trading approaches and improving profitability.

Your profile

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

• Proven experience (> 10 years) in trading within the energy sector, with a strong grasp of market dynamics and asset optimization strategies.

• Exceptional analytical skills, with proficiency in quantitative analysis and algorithmic trading.

• Strong leadership capabilities with a track record of building and managing high-performing teams.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
